prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On a weekday afternoon in Pasadena, Texas, I responded to a two-vehicle collision involving a sideswipe during a lane change. Driver 1 was operating a sedan in the center lane when the vehicle to the left, driven by Driver 2, moved into the same space and made contact along the driver's side. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for the sedan, and the vehicle was registered to the same address. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was transported to a local hospital for evaluation. A passenger was also in the sedan, and both the passenger and Driver 1 confirmed that Driver 1 was behind the wheel at the time of the impact. No independent witnesses were located at the scene. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the left side of the sedan and the right rear quarter panel of the second vehicle, and the visible damage is generally consistent with the reported impact. Neither driver reported prior damage to either vehicle, and none was observed. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a lateral collision of this kind. Both drivers were issued citations pending further review.
